name: 圣光汲取
description: 选择1个拥有【圣盾】的友方，移除其【圣盾】，获得1张【圣光惩戒】和1张【圣光治疗】。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var player = battle.players.find(function(item) { return item.playerId === caster.ownerPlayerId; }); if (!player) return { success: false, message: '未找到玩家' }; if (!player.hand) player.hand = []; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 99, filter: 'ally' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var shield = target.statusTags && target.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'divine-shield'; }); if (!shield) return { success: false, message: '目标没有圣盾' }; removeStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, shield.id); removeRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-divine-shield'); addCardToHand('holy-smite', player.playerId); addCardToHand('holy-heal', player.playerId); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '汲取了' + target.name + '的圣盾，生成圣光惩戒和圣光治疗' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: skillDef.description, expectedValues: {"generatedCards":2} }; }
